Austria-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical problems of the final round (national competition) of the Austrian Chemistry Olympiad, from the official English versions published by the organisers (oecho.at); each problem keeps its author line as printed. Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.

BChO-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical problems only. Where the original English examination paper is available (University of Tartu archive) it is the source; for the other years the source is the English text of the problem collection compiled by the University of Tartu (labelled as a secondary source). Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.

Canada-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Papers of the Canadian Chemistry Contest of the Chemical Institute of Canada: Part A (multiple choice, one record per question), Part B (extended-response essay questions) and Part C (Canadian Chemistry Olympiad, final selection examination), from the official English papers published by the CIC (cheminst.ca). Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.

IChO-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical problems only (practical problems are not included yet). Each statement is transcribed from the official English paper and checked part by part against its page images; for the early years without an official English paper the source is the IChO compendium (A. Sirota et al.) and is labelled as such. Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.

IMChO-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theoretical problems only: Tour 1 (compulsory problems) and Tour 2 (problems by section: analytical, inorganic, organic, physical, life sciences and polymers), each numbered as printed. Each statement is transcribed from the official English paper published by the organisers (Lomonosov Moscow State University) and checked against its page images; years without an official English paper are not included. Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.

Netherlands-theory-problems.json.verification_notes: Theory papers of the Dutch National Chemistry Olympiad (Nationale Scheikundeolympiade): preliminary rounds 1 and 2 and the final-round theory test, from the official English versions published by the national committee (scheikundeolympiade.science.ru.nl). The multiple-choice part of each preliminary round is split into one record per printed topic. Statements only: no solutions, answers or marking schemes.
